dataset_name: IMD-MoES Multi-Modal Heavy Rainfall & 2D Urban Inundation Dataset (2018-2025)
organization: Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), Government of India

features.name: record_id
features.description: Unique observation identifier

features.name: timestamp_utc
features.description: ISO-8601 observation timestamp

features.name: basin_id
features.description: 1km x 1km target flood grid identifier

features.name: synoptic_regime
features.description: Monsoon depression, cloudburst, cyclonic landfall, or convective squall

features.name: insat_3ds_tir1_bt_k
features.description: INSAT-3DS Thermal Infrared-1 (10.8 um) cloud-top brightness temperature (lower K = deeper convection)

features.name: gsmap_isro_rain_mm_hr
features.description: INSAT-3DS + GSMaP-ISRO satellite microwave-IR rain rate estimate

features.name: imd_dwr_reflectivity_dbz
features.description: IMD S-Band/C-Band Doppler Weather Radar Max-Z column reflectivity

features.name: dwr_radial_velocity_m_s
features.description: Doppler radar radial wind convergence velocity

features.name: aws_ground_gauge_mm_hr
features.description: IMD Automated Weather Station (AWS) / ARG tipping-bucket rain rate

features.name: ncmrwf_nwp_1km_mm_hr
features.description: IMD GFS / NCMRWF NCUM downscaled 1km numerical weather prediction rain rate

features.name: antecedent_rain_3h_mm
features.description: Cumulative 3-hour antecedent precipitation prior to t=0

features.name: scs_curve_number
features.description: NRSC/USDA SCS Runoff Curve Number reflecting imperviousness and land use

features.name: soil_moisture_saturation_pct
features.description: Top-layer volumetric soil moisture saturation percentage

features.name: dem_elevation_m
features.description: CartoSAT-1 / LiDAR 1m Digital Elevation Model mean cell elevation

features.name: topographic_wetness_index
features.description: DEM-derived Topographic Wetness Index indicating flow accumulation propensity

features.name: drainage_efficiency_pct
features.description: Active municipal storm-water drainage & SCADA pumping capacity

features.name: tidal_backwater_level_m
features.description: Coastal/estuarine tidal stage inducing backwater lock at outfalls

features.name: target_fused_rain_mm_hr
features.description: Ground-truth gauge-corrected multi-source fused rainfall intensity

features.name: target_runoff_mm_hr
features.description: Observed/validated SCS-CN direct surface runoff rate

features.name: target_inundation_depth_m
features.description: Ground-truth peak street-level water depth (AWLR / Sentinel-1 SAR / CCTV gauge)
